opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities or other UK higher education institutions (including trial independent research institutes) must be the applicant institution; principal investigator must be employed by the institution.
opportunities.summary: Funding for innovative research projects up to five years, covering staff costs (minimum 75% of budget) and associated research costs, with a maximum grant value of £500,000.

opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: £56,000 (year 1) and £28,000 (years 2‑3) plus up to £6,000 per annum for research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers who have not yet held a full‑time permanent academic post in the UK; must hold a doctorate by the closing date.
opportunities.summary: Supports early‑career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable work; fellowship lasts three years with salary contribution up to £56,000 in year 1 and 50 % of salary up to £28,000 in years 2‑3, plus research expenses.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers employed by a UK university with research degree awarding powers; must be resident in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £70,000 to experienced researchers whose teaching/administrative duties have limited their research; fellowship length 3‑24 months.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career scholars with at least two years post‑PhD experience, holding a permanent UK university appointment (or nominated), and not previously leading a research team.
opportunities.summary: Supports early‑career scholars to build a modest research team and demonstrate leadership; award up to £1 million for 4‑5 years.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK university academic staff (or specialist arts institutions) must apply on behalf of an overseas eminent professor; institution must administer the grant.
opportunities.summary: Funds visits of eminent overseas professors to UK institutions for 3‑12 months (or up to 2 years if spread); aims to bring novel expertise and skills.

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Distinguished researchers in humanities or social sciences employed by a UK university with research degree awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: Two‑ or three‑year fellowships for established scholars whose teaching duties have limited research; includes salary and up to £6,000 per year for research expenses.

opportunities.title: Philip Leverhulme Prizes
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers at an early career stage (doctoral award ≤10 years ago) holding a permanent UK university post or long‑term fellowship.
opportunities.summary: Individual prize of £100,000 (2‑3 years) to support any research purpose; rotates across 20 subject areas.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Retired UK university staff (or eligible independent research institute) who are UK resident and have an established research record.
opportunities.summary: Supports retired researchers to complete a research project; fellowship 3‑24 months, award between £3k‑£24k.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities with research degree awarding powers (or consortia of up to two universities) may apply; awards are to institutions, not individuals.
opportunities.summary: Centenary Doctoral Scholarships fund up to 30 doctoral scholarships (plus master‑plus‑PhD routes) and related post‑doctoral and cohort‑building activities; total award up to £5 million over 9 years.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities (registered with the Office for Students and holding research degree awarding powers) may apply as lead or partner; collaborative centres encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Supports establishment of large‑scale research centres (up to 10 years, up to £10 million) to achieve step‑change in scholarship across any discipline.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship – Under 18s
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities in the UK; institutions apply on behalf of school‑age students; individual students cannot apply directly.
opportunities.summary: Funds training opportunities for school‑age children (under 18) in fine and performing arts; awards run for three years starting 1 Sept 2025.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship – Undergraduate & Postgraduate
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or charities in the UK; institutions apply on behalf of undergraduate/postgraduate students; individual students cannot apply directly.
opportunities.summary: Provides bursaries of £5,000‑£10,000 per year per student for undergraduate or postgraduate arts study; awards can start between 2025‑2027.
